svg.title: Volunteer coordinator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as volunteer coordinator, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A volunteer rota with attendance marks sits above an open offering hand. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
